event_name: Date 01 August 2020 Time 11:04 2020 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 30 July - 2 August 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 20), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 23.5 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
reason: The gearbox of car 26 has been changed before 6 consecutive events have expired.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 26 New Gearbox
